items.name: AREX (Airport Railroad Express & All-Stop Train)
items.claimed_text: 2a. Arex (airport train) 45 min, $7

items.verified_cost: Express Train: 13,000 KRW (~$9.50 USD), 43 min (T1) / 51 min (T2); All-Stop Train: 4,750 KRW (T1) / 5,350 KRW (T2) (~$3.50–$3.95 USD), 59–66 min

items.irregularity_flag: Fare & Route Discrepancy: Official AREX Express fare is 13,000 KRW (~$9.50 USD, increased from the older 9,500 KRW / ~$7 rate). Also, AREX terminates at Seoul Station (not Myeongdong), requiring a Line 4 subway transfer or taxi with luggage (total door-to-door time ~65–75 min).

items.name: Namsan Seoul Tower (N Seoul Tower) & Namsan Cable Car
items.claimed_text: 1. Take bus to Namsun Tower (N Seoul Tower). 31 min. bus ride. Cost: For cable car + Observatory ticket: $31 each. Hours: Observatory 10:00-10:30 (entry until 10:00). Cable Car Hours: 10:00-10:30 (weather permitting)
items.verified_location: Tower: 105 Namsangongwon-gil, Yongsan-gu, Seoul | Cable Car Lower Station: 83 Sopa-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul
items.verified_hours: Observatory: Mon–Fri 10:00–22:30 (Last entry 22:00), Sat–Sun/Holidays 10:00–23:00 (Last entry 22:30) | Cable Car: Daily 10:00–23:00 (Last round-trip ticket 22:30, one-way 22:45)
items.verified_days_open: Daily (365 days; Namsan Ormi outdoor incline elevator to Cable Car is closed Mondays 09:00–14:00 for maintenance)
items.verified_cost: Observatory Adult: 29,000 KRW (~$21.15 USD) | Cable Car Adult: 15,000 KRW round-trip / 12,000 KRW one-way (~$10.90 / $8.75 USD) | Combined Onsite: 44,000 KRW (~$31.80 USD)
items.transit_from_hotel: Option A (Cable Car): Walk 12 min uphill from Stanford Hotel via Myeongdong Station Exit 3 to Namsan Cable Car Lower Station (note: Namsan Ormi elevator closed Mon 09:00–14:00). Option B (Shuttle Bus): Board Namsan Shuttle Bus 01A or 01B at Lotte Young Plaza / Myeongdong Station Exit 3 (~20–25 min, 1,400 KRW) directly to N Seoul Tower summit (bypasses Cable Car).
items.irregularity_flag: 1) Year typo in heading ('Nov 2, 2006' -> 2026) and spelling ('Namsun' -> Namsan). 2) Taking the bus to the tower bypasses the Cable Car; choose either Bus 01A/01B OR the Cable Car (or Cable Car up, Bus down). 3) Namsan Ormi outdoor incline elevator to the Cable Car is closed Mondays 09:00–14:00. 4) Cable Car operates until 23:00 (11:00 PM), not 10:30 PM; Observatory weekday hours are 10:00–22:30 (last entry 22:00).
items.official_source_title: N Seoul Tower Official Hours & Admission

items.name: Gwangjang Market & Gohyang Kalguksu (Netflix Hand-Cut Noodles)
items.claimed_text: Gwangjang Market - Authentic local cuisine. Netflix famous-get hand-cut noodles. Hours: 9:00-11:00pm. (Some food stalls open until 2:00a.m.)
items.verified_location: 88 Changgyeonggung-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul (Gohyang Kalguksu is Stall A70 in East Gate Food Alley)
items.verified_hours: Gwangjang Food Alley: Daily 09:00–23:00 (General shops 09:00–18:00, closed Sun) | Gohyang Kalguksu (Stall A70): Tue–Sun 09:00–21:00 (CLOSED MONDAYS & 4th Sunday)
items.verified_days_open: Food Alley: Daily | Gohyang Kalguksu: Tue–Sun (Closed Mondays)
items.transit_from_hotel: From Euljiro 1(il)-ga Station (Line 2), ride 2 stops to Euljiro 4(sa)-ga Station (Exit 4) and walk 5 min north (~12 min total), or walk 20 min along Cheonggyecheon Stream.
items.irregularity_flag: CRITICAL MONDAY CLOSURE: Day 2 is Monday (Nov 2, 2026), and Cho Yonsoon's Netflix-featured hand-cut noodle stall (Gohyang Kalguksu, Stall A70) is CLOSED EVERY MONDAY! Also, Gwangjang Food Alley closes by 23:00 (not 2:00 AM). Visit Gwangjang Market on Tue–Sat instead if you want Gohyang Kalguksu.

items.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace (경복궁)
items.claimed_text: 1. Gyeongbokgung Palace (Hours: November-February 9:00-5:00pm (Last admission 4:00. Closed: Tuesdays (If Tuesday falls on a public holiday, closed on following business day)) Time needed: 3-4 hours. Admission: 3,000 KRW (~$2.30), Free for under 19 and over 65
items.verified_location: 161 Sajik-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul (Subway Line 3 Gyeongbokgung Station, Exit 5)
items.verified_days_open: Wed–Mon (CLOSED EVERY TUESDAY; Nov 3, 2026 is a regular Tuesday, not a public holiday)
items.verified_cost: Adults (19–64): 3,000 KRW | Foreign youth (18 & under) and seniors (65+): Free | Wearing Hanbok: Free
items.transit_from_hotel: From Stanford Hotel, walk 2 min to Euljiro 1(il)-ga Station (Line 2) -> ride 1 stop to Euljiro 3(sam)-ga Station -> transfer to Line 3 (toward Daehwa) -> ride 2 stops to Gyeongbokgung Station Exit 5 (~15 min total, 1,400 KRW). Or take Bus 109, 171, 272, 601, or 606 from Lotte Dept. Store (~12 min).
items.irregularity_flag: CRITICAL SCHEDULING CONFLICT: Day 3 is Tuesday, Nov 3, 2026, and Gyeongbokgung Palace is CLOSED EVERY TUESDAY! Because Nov 3 is not a public holiday, the palace will be closed. Swap Day 3 (Tuesday) with Day 4 (Wednesday) or Day 6 (Friday), OR visit Changdeokgung Palace (open Tuesdays, closed Mondays).
items.official_source_title: Korea Heritage Service — Gyeongbokgung Palace Official

items.name: Gyeongbokgung Changing of the Royal Guard Ceremony
items.claimed_text: 2. Must-see: Main palace of Joseon Dynasty, changing of the guard ceremony (10:00 AM, 2:00 PM, closed on Tuesdays)
items.verified_location: Gwanghwamun Gate Plaza (inside main gate of Gyeongbokgung Palace), 161 Sajik-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul
items.verified_hours: 10:00 and 14:00 (duration ~20 minutes); Gwanghwamun Gate Guard-on-Duty Ritual at 11:00 and 13:00
items.verified_cost: Free (takes place in front of Gwanghwamun Gate before the paid ticket barrier)
items.transit_from_hotel: Same as Gyeongbokgung Palace (Line 3 Gyeongbokgung Station Exit 5 or Line 5 Gwanghwamun Station Exit 2).
items.irregularity_flag: CRITICAL SCHEDULING CONFLICT: The Changing of the Guard Ceremony does NOT take place on Tuesdays (Nov 3, 2026). Swap Day 3 with Wednesday/Friday, or watch the Deoksugung Palace Royal Guard Changing Ceremony (held Tuesdays at 11:00, 14:00, and 15:30).

items.verified_hours: 10:00–17:00 ONLY for tourists in the Bukchon-ro 11-gil Special Management Red Zone (Restricted curfew: 17:00–10:00)

items.irregularity_flag: MANDATORY CURFEW ALERT: Seoul Metropolitan Gov. & Jongno-gu strictly enforce a tourist visiting curfew in Bukchon Hanok Village's core Red Zone (Bukchon-ro 11-gil): tourists may ONLY visit between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM (17:00). Violators face a 100,000 KRW fine.
items.official_source_title: Seoul Metropolitan Government — Bukchon Tourist Restriction Notice
